ttm_clean.scenario: Clean build: main.cpp includes the pinned host API and does no device work, beside a data-movement kernel under kernels/ that includes a device header and so would fail if the host compiler built it; empty stderr, exit status 0

ttm_header_error.scenario: Error in an included header: main.cpp includes host/scale.h, whose inline function uses the undeclared identifier factor, so clang prints the include chain before the error

ttm_linker_error.scenario: Linker error: main calls helper, which is declared and never defined, so ld.lld reports an undefined symbol and the clang driver reports that the linker command failed

ttm_missing_header.scenario: Missing header: main.cpp includes tt-metalium/p410_no_such_header.hpp, which the pinned tree does not hold, a fatal error at the include line

ttm_note_chain.scenario: Note chain: main calls scale with an int array, which matches neither the float nor the double overload, so the error is followed by one candidate note per overload

ttm_syntax_error.scenario: Syntax error: the declaration of total in main has no semicolon before the for loop

ttm_undeclared_identifier.scenario: Undeclared identifier: a loop body in main uses undefined_var, which is never declared

ttm_unused_parameter.scenario: Warning that stays a warning: scale_value never uses its parameter factor, so the pinned -Wunused-parameter warns, and without -Werror (OQ-027, option (b)) the build succeeds, exit status 0
